name: Dikshabandooni Singh
quote: We were fortunate to find this wonderful teacher for my twin boys. She is lovely, patient, and dedicated—building strong fundamentals while making learning fun and engaging each week.

name: Riddhi Avlani
quote: My son takes tuitions from Kriana Tutoring and I can already see the difference. Jignasa is incredibly patient with her students—thank you!

name: Rashmi Sinha
quote: The mentor is very friendly and has a deep understanding of the students. She knows how to spark curiosity so learners gain a better grasp of every concept.

name: Namrata Gunjal
quote: My son goes every week, and Kriana is hands-down the most patient and understanding teacher. Special shoutout to Jiggish as well! My 6th grader just finished his coding classes and had an absolute blast—it was so fun-loaded and engaging. We are so happy to be part of this learning community.

name: Bhagyashri Patil
quote: I’m really happy with the math tutoring sessions. The tutor takes time to understand the student’s weak areas and works on them patiently. My child’s grades and confidence have both improved. Highly recommend for anyone struggling with math!

name: Priya Kapoor
quote: Kriana Tutoring has been a game changer for my daughter's confidence in reading and writing. The sessions are structured but never feel like a chore—she actually looks forward to them every week.

name: Steven Wallace
quote: We enrolled our son for math support and within a couple of months his report card showed real improvement. The tutors communicate regularly and genuinely care about progress, not just attendance.

name: Fatima Noor
quote: Starting tutoring this early felt like a big decision, but the team made it so easy. They're patient, warm, and know exactly how to keep a five-year-old engaged while still building real skills.

name: Michael Chen
quote: Finding a tutor who can handle two very different learning styles at once isn't easy, but Kriana pulled it off. Both of my kids are more confident readers now and ask to do their 'homework with Miss J.'
